Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AXP.
Our cloud segment grew 5% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $32.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1304 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 110 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $32.5 billion this quarter, representing 5% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 5% to 24% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
